definitions.full: H4761. marashah [ מְרַאֲשׁוֺת ] noun [feminine] plural denominative place at the head, head-place ; — only suffix מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו as adverb at his head-place (of one lying down) Gen 28:11 , 18 (E), 1Sam 19:13 , 16 ; 1Kin 19:6 ; so Qr 1Sam 26:7 , 11 , 16 ; (Kt מראשׁתו ); in 26:12 read ᵐ5 מִמְּרַאֲשֹׁתָיו .
